summary: This best current practice gives guidelines for authors and reviewers of specifications containing YANG modules. The recommendations and procedures aim to improve interoperability and usability of NETCONF and RESTCONF implementations. It was later replaced by RFC 9907.

eli5.summary: A style guide for people who write network data forms, so the forms are neat and work together. It was later replaced by RFC 9907.

questions: what are the guidelines for writing yang modules
how to review a yang module
